d:
Between April and September, India imported almost the same amount of crude oil as last year. The bill went up by almost $29 billion. In the same six months, Reliance's oil-to-chemicals business earned 68% more, and America's Secretary of State flew to Jamnagar.
In this Breakdown, Rahul tracks who actually paid for this year's oil shock. He looks at what it did to the rupee and the Union Budget, why one refinery in Gujarat earned more while processing less, and why Washington suddenly cares about it.
